narrative:
## Handover Summary — Contract Revenue & Volume

Revenue validated across six divisions, sixteen contracts and five channels. The Contract Revenue & Volume Agent generated 15 proposals; 11 were accepted.

## Key Decisions
• Pension Solutions +2.5% on CSPS backlog and Teachers' Pensions volumes
• Contact Centre −2.3% as virtual agents contain 18% of contacts
• Regulated Services −9.4% for the earlier handbacks
• TfL price per transaction +3% under the July renewal

## Recommendation for Cost to Serve
Release roster hours on the council contracts in step with containment, and keep the CSPS surge cost visible in Pension Solutions cost to serve.
